title: "mat_num2color"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = ">"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(saferMatrix)
```
<br>

### Datasets

```{r}
mat1 <- matrix(c(1,1,1,2, 5,2,3,NA, 5,5,1,1, 5,5,5,1), ncol = 4)
mat2 <- matrix(c(1/3,1/3,1/3,1/7, 1/3,1/3,1/9,1/3, 1/3,1/7,1/3,1/3, 1/9,1/3,1/3,1/3), ncol = 4)
```
<br>

### Datasets info

```{r}
mat1
mat2
```
<br>

### Simple examples

```{r}
mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2)
```
<br>

### Argument mat_hsv_h
```{r}
mat_num2color(mat1 = mat1, mat_hsv_h = FALSE)

mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, mat_hsv_h = TRUE)
```
<br>

### Argument notch
```{r}
mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, notch = 0.2)

mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, notch = 0.5)

mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, notch = 0.7)
```
<br>

### Argument s
```{r}
mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, s = 0.2)

mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, s = 0.2)

mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, s = 0.2)
```
<br>

### Argument v
```{r}
mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, v = 0.2)

mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, v = 0.5)

mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, v = 0.7)
```
<br>

### Argument forced_color
```{r}
mat_num2color(mat1 = mat2, forced_color = "snow")
```
<br>

### All the arguments
```{r}
mat_num2color(
        mat1 = mat1, 
        mat_hsv_h = FALSE, 
        notch = 1, 
        s = 1, 
        v = 1, 
        forced_color = NULL
)

mat_num2color(
        mat1 = mat2, 
        mat_hsv_h = TRUE, 
        notch = 1, 
        s = 1, 
        v = 1, 
        forced_color = NULL
)
```
